description.value:
Duration constant

Maximum 2 banked points

Charge generated past your Bloomrot cap is banked instead of lost, up to 2 points. The banked points are released the next time you move the needle, applied in the direction you move it, and they may carry the needle past your cap; this release is the only thing that can. Banked points survive the needle's overnight reset. §3's Reset governs the needle alone -- it returns to 0 after a night's rest and at no other time -- so the bank is the one value on this class that persists.

cinderfall.incomplete: `BLOOMROT-NULL` end to end — there is no cap, no charge, and no reset to bank against.
